task_definition.task_description: Please check the status of flight AA100, prepare a business-class booking for Jordan Lee, and get the New York weather alert, then publish that alert to my app. After that, book the flight, create and send a New York trip weather brief by email, push the notification to my app too, then check my main smart lock and lock it with PIN 2026, and finally email traveler@example.com with the subject "Your trip booking and home lock update" saying the flight was booked successfully.

user_input.query: Please check the status of flight AA100, then prepare a business-class booking for Jordan Lee to New York. Also get the New York weather alert and publish that alert to my app for user_123. After that, book the flight, create a New York trip weather brief titled "NYC Trip Weather Brief" and send it by email to traveler@example.com, and push that notification to my app too. Then check my main smart lock, which is lock_main, and lock it using PIN 2026. Finally, email traveler@example.com with the subject "Your trip booking and home lock update" and say that the flight was booked successfully.
